tools.name: connect
tools.line: Open the SSH connection registered under this id.

tools.name: disconnect
tools.line: Close one open SSH connection.

tools.name: focus_connection
tools.line: Point subsequent file and command operations at one of the already-open connections.

tools.name: session_status
tools.line: List every connection sshboard currently holds open, where the AI may write on each, and which one file and command operations currently go to.

tools.name: list_connections
tools.line: List the connections registered in sshboard.

tools.name: register_connection
tools.line: Register one connection in sshboard's local list.

tools.name: update_connection
tools.line: Change name, key path, tag or colour of a connection already in sshboard's local list.

tools.name: mark_connection
tools.line: Set the tag and colour mark on an existing connection.

tools.name: list_directory
tools.line: List one directory on the connected server.

tools.name: stat
tools.line: Look at one file or directory on the connected server: size, permissions (octal), last modified time and owner ids.

tools.name: read_file
tools.line: Read one file from the connected server as text.

tools.name: search
tools.line: Search the connected server for files by name, or for text inside files.

tools.name: read_log
tools.line: Read the last lines of one log file on the connected server (tail).

tools.name: disk_usage
tools.line: Report free disk space on the connected server (df).

tools.name: process_list
tools.line: List the processes running on the connected server (ps).

tools.name: network_listen
tools.line: List the TCP ports the connected server is listening on.

tools.name: service_status
tools.line: Show the status of one systemd service on the connected server.

tools.name: runtime_versions
tools.line: Report the operating system of the connected server and the versions of the language runtimes it has.

tools.name: make_directory
tools.line: Create a directory (and missing parents) on the connected server.

tools.name: upload_file
tools.line: Upload one local file to the connected server.

tools.name: write_file
tools.line: Write text to a file on the connected server.

tools.name: list_readonly_commands
tools.line: List the commands a human has allowed sshboard to run for you, with the exact text each one runs.

tools.name: run_readonly
tools.line: Run one of the commands a human listed in sshboard's allowlist, chosen by its id.

tools.name: list_operations
tools.line: List the state-changing operations the human has listed in operations.toml: their ids, what each one actually runs, the description the human wrote, and the hou…

tools.name: run_operation
tools.line: Run one of the state-changing operations the human listed in operations.toml, by id.

tools.name: console_open
tools.line: Ask the person at the screen for the interactive console on the connected server.

tools.name: console_type
tools.line: Type into the console you are holding.

tools.name: console_stop
tools.line: Let go of the console and close the shell.

tools.name: read_stream
tools.line: Read the plain-text tail of the output sshboard is following.

tools.name: show_view
tools.line: Ask the person at the screen to look at one of sshboard's tabs: connections, files, console, band or diag.

tools.name: capture_window
tools.line: Photograph the sshboard window and return it as a PNG, so you can see what the app actually renders — a broken layout, a menu that fell back to English, text ov…

tools.name: pending_status
tools.line: Check whether the person has answered anything you asked for: the console hold, a key passphrase, a host key to confirm, or an operation approval.

tools.name: diagnostics
tools.line: Read sshboard's recent diagnostic log: which stage each attempt reached, why it stopped, and what to do next.

tools.name: about_sshboard
tools.line: What sshboard is, what you as an AI may and may not do through it, and what changed in each version.

tools.name: ping
tools.line: Check that sshboard is reachable.
